column3: An unannotated Spring parameter binds as a query parameter; FastAPI binds a parameter named like a path token to the path.

Spring's RequestMethodsRequestCondition.combine() unions the class-level and method-level HTTP methods; neither FastAPI nor Flask has a class-level method mapping to combine with a route's own methods.
FastAPI has no restrictive consumes condition counterpart.
Bean Validation skips nested objects without @Valid; pydantic validates nested models.
Spring Data Page serialization is specific to Spring Data.
